svg.text: One control plane for agent-driven operations — built on Minikube, portable to EKS / GKE / AKS.
No agent writes to a cluster directly — every action clears policy first.
THE PORTABILITY SEAM — the Kubernetes API
Everything above this line is plain Kubernetes + Helm + Git. Moving to a cloud cluster replaces the substrate below, not the platform above.
